KEITH THOMAS
Madison, Wis.
Keith Thomas has been driving midget autos,
mostly on the Badger Midget Racing circuit, since
1951. He was champion of the Badger group for the
1961 and 1962 seasons. Tried his hand at sprint car
racing but had a couple of accidents and near acci-
dents, then switched his full attention back to the
small cars. Qualified for the 1959, 100 mile United
States Auto Club midget auto race here on the big
track, finishing 19th, competing against the best in
the midget auto racing sport. Thomas drives a car
sponsored by Paul Krueger of Madison, Wis.

DICK SCHETTER
MEL CORNETT
Two products of the rough, tough modified stock car racing circuit in southeastern Wisconsin who have
turned to midget auto racing with success are Dick Schetter and Mel Cornet, both of Milwaukee.
Schetter, who operates a Mobil service station at 683 S. Hawley road, started driving modified stock cars
in 1961, the same year Cornett broke into the sport. Both had varying degrees of success and more than their
share of bad breaks.
Last year was Schetter's first in midget auto racing, and Cornett's third. Schetter won a feature and a
number of preliminary events. Cornett also took the checkered flag in several races.
Cornett ranked 10th in the last published Badger Midget standings, while Schetter, plagued by a string
of mechanical troubles, ranked 24th.
